Maya K.: FYI — we observed repeated burst-induced throttles in eu-west-2 during the promo window (08:30–09:00UTC). Not classic OOM, but a combination of per-node saturation + KV-cache growth produced transient per-request throttles.

Jordan P.: Can you paste p99 and per-node GPU/mem numbers?

Maya K.: p50 62ms / p95 270ms / p99 1.2s during peak. GPU util distribution: most nodes ~60–70% but 6 nodes pinned at 95–99%. Node mem trending: 68% median, 88% on hot nodes. Scheduler queued requests spiked +15%.

```
Metric snapshot 2026-03-17T08:42Z
- p99_latency_ms: 1200
- queued_requests: +15%
- nodes_high_util: 6
- avg_gpu_util: 72
- avg_node_mem: 68
- hot_node_mem: 88
```

Lina S.: Did autoscaler kick? I see a 2m delay — likely blocked by quota checks.

Ryan M.: Yeah quota hit for g5x in eu-west-2. Reserved capacity was sized for hourly traffic, not 3–4 minute microbursts during the promo. Forecast smoothing erased those spikes.

Jordan P.: Root cause summary: forecasting horizon smoothing + insufficient pre-warmed headroom + per-node KV retention. Short-term microbursts weren't captured by the daily/hourly model.

SRE Oncall: Learnings: 1) Forecast model needs a microburst-aware signal (short lookback + event flags). 2) Autoscaler should have a soft pre-warm path that doesn't require full quota approval. 3) Per-node cache retention should be aggressive during promos.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: rolled back model_variant:v2-e2e in eu-west-2 at 2026-03-17T08:50Z to reduce memory footprint.

Maya K.: Proposed actions:
- [ ] Update forecast pipeline to emit 1–5m microburst metrics and a promo multiplier
- [ ] Add pre-warm policy for scheduled promos (pre-authorize soft quota bump up to X GPUs)
- [ ] Reduce KV cache retention from 30m -> 10m for promo windows
- [ ] Run synthetic burst tests in staging (script: `tools/load-exercise --bursts 20 --dur 180s`)

Ryan M.: I'll own quota conversation with cloud partner. Lina, can you add the autoscaler change? @Jordan P. please open RFC for forecasting change.

Jordan P.: Opening RFC now, will include sample SQL+model code to compute microburst score and proposed default multiplier.

Maya K.: Retro scheduled 2026-03-18 10:00UTC. Quick thread — bring logs and request traces. :thumbsup:
